newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - April 23.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - April 23.

text.p: * International Business Machines Corp is expected to report first quarter earnings of $2.28 a share, compared to $2.21 a year ago, according to First Call. IBM is to report results after the market close. IBM shares were down 1/4 at 139-1/4 in London.
* Chevron Corp is expected to report first quarter earnings per share of $1.13, compared to $0.94 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 66-5/8 Tuesday.
* Mobil Corp is expected to report first quarter earnings per share of $2.02, compared to $1.83 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 125-7/8.
* DuPont Co is expected to report first quarter earnings per share of $1.76, compared to $1.61 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 108-1/4.
* Phillips Petroleum Co is expected to report first quarter earnings of $0.95 a share. compared to $0.80 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 38-1/2.
